definitions.coefficient_error: E_j = max_l abs(predicted_theta[j,l] - true_theta[j,l]); absolute coefficient error, not relative error
definitions.total_error: E = E_a + E_b + E_c + E_f; strict threshold comparison
definitions.improvement_ratio: first solve total error / last solve total error; missing values assigned 1 to retain legacy plotting convention
definitions.family_entropy: -sum(p_i log2(p_i)) / log2(5), over the final solve taxonomy: polynomial/trigonometric/exponential/localized/other; later queries are omitted
definitions.action_stack: separate per-action medians, summed; not the median total action count
definitions.population_sd: ddof=0 across the ten archived runs; descriptive variation, not a confidence interval
definitions.calibration: pool a/b/c reports; pair with latest solve on an earlier transcript turn with queries_at_solve <= report query count; omit reports without prior solve; event is E_j < 0.1
definitions.calibration_bins: disjoint [lo,hi), with 1 in the final bin; plot mean stated confidence against empirical success fraction; marker area in points squared is 5 + 1.1 times bin count

changes_from_legacy_assets: GPT-5.4 mini hard success at E < 0.01 is 2/10 in both run logs and sweep_results.json; the checked-in PNG displays 0/10.
Calibration uses causally available solve outputs and disjoint confidence bins, replacing forward-looking solve matching and overlapping bin boundaries.
Improvement figure shows individual runs and medians on a logarithmic axis; it omits arithmetic-mean bars and standard-deviation whiskers.
